headline: The Problem: Lab Delays Cost Millions
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 500 340" width="500" height="340" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <!-- Drop shadow for cards -->
    <filter id="shadow" x="-4" y="-4" width="108" height="108" filterUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="#1e293b" flood-opacity="0.12" />
    </filter>

    <!-- Dashed path stroke for timeline -->
    <marker id="arrowhead" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="6" refX="7" refY="3" orient="auto">
      <path d="M 0 0 L 8 3 L 0 6 Z" fill="#64748b" />
    </marker>

    <!-- Clip path for the main flowchart area -->
    <clipPath id="flowchart-clip">
      <rect x="20" y="74" width="460" height="244" rx="12" />
    </clipPath>

    <!-- Diagonal hatch pattern for the delayed path -->
    <pattern id="hatch" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" width="6" height="6" patternTransform="rotate(45)">
      <rect width="6" height="6" fill="#e8f4ec" />
      <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="6" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2.5" />
    </pattern>

    <!-- Progress bar background pattern -->
    <pattern id="bar-bg" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" width="6" height="6">
      <rect width="6" height="6" fill="#f1f5f9" />
      <line x1="0" y1="3" x2="6" y2="3" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="2,2" />
    </pattern>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="500" height="340" fill="#f8fafc" />
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="500" height="56" fill="#ffffff" />
  <rect x="0" y="56" width="500" height="1" fill="#e2e8f0" />

  <!-- Title Section -->
  <text x="30" y="26" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b">The Problem: Lab Delays Cost Millions</text>
  <text x="30" y="44" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#64748b">Portable XRF vs. Traditional Lab Workflows</text>

  <!-- ================== LEGACY PATH (LEFT COLUMN) ================== -->
  <!-- Background Card -->
  <rect x="30" y="74" width="210" height="244" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" filter="url(#shadow)" />
  
  <!-- Top Label with Warning Icon -->
  <rect x="30" y="74" width="210" height="42" rx="12" fill="#fef3c7" clip-path="url(#flowchart-clip)" />
  <rect x="30" y="116" width="210" height="12" fill="#fef3c7" clip-path="url(#flowchart-clip)" />
  <circle cx="48" cy="101" r="10" fill="#d97706" />
  <text x="44" y="105" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">!</text>
  <text x="64" y="99" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b">Legacy Lab Workflow</text>
  <text x="64" y="114" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#64748b">High Cost & Delayed Results</text>

  <!-- Step 1: Collect -->
  <rect x="46" y="136" width="178" height="40" rx="6" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="58" y="155" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b">1. Collect Sample</text>
  <text x="58" y="169" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9" fill="#64748b">Field extraction & logging</text>

  <!-- Arrow 1 -->
  <path d="M 135 176 L 135 194" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="3 2" marker-end="url(#arrowhead)" />

  <!-- Step 2: Transport -->
  <rect x="46" y="200" width="178" height="40" rx="6" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="58" y="219" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b">2. Transport to Lab</text>
  <text x="58" y="233" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9" fill="#64748b">Chain of custody & shipping</text>

  <!-- Arrow 2 -->
  <path d="M 135 240 L 135 258" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="3 2" marker-end="url(#arrowhead)" />

  <!-- Step 3: Wait for Results -->
  <rect x="46" y="264" width="178" height="40" rx="6" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="58" y="283" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b">3. Wait for Results</text>
  <text x="58" y="297" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9" fill="#64748b">Days of idle plant & uncertainty</text>

  <!-- Badges on Legacy Path -->
  <rect x="140" y="132" width="94" height="22" rx="11" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="187" y="146" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#d97706">1-2 Days</text>

  <rect x="140" y="196" width="94" height="22" rx="11" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="187" y="210" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#d97706">1-3 Days</text>

  <rect x="135" y="260" width="104" height="22" rx="11" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="187" y="274" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#d97706">3-5 Days</text>

  <!-- ================== COST / IMPACT STRIP ================== -->
  <!-- Vertical Divider -->
  <line x1="250" y1="74" x2="250" y2="318" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6 4" />

  <!-- Cost Strip Background -->
  <rect x="250" y="74" width="40" height="244" fill="#1e293b" clip-path="url(#flowchart-clip)" />
  
  <!-- Impact Bubbles -->
  <circle cx="270" cy="150" r="22" fill="#d97706" />
  <path d="M 262 142 L 265 142 L 270 152 L 275 142 L 278 142 L 270 155 Z" fill="#ffffff" />
  <text x="270" y="173" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">COST</text>

  <circle cx="270" cy="225" r="22" fill="#ef4444" />
  <path d="M 264 224 L 266 227 L 270 224 L 274 227 L 276 224 L 270 218 Z" fill="#ffffff" />
  <path d="M 270 225 L 270 218" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2" />
  <text x="270" y="248" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">RISK</text>

  <!-- Diagonal accent line crossing the strip -->
  <line x1="246" y1="318" x2="294" y2="74" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.1" />

  <!-- ================== XRF PATH (RIGHT COLUMN) ================== -->
  <!-- Background Card -->
  <rect x="300" y="74" width="180" height="244" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" filter="url(#shadow)" />

  <!-- Top Label with Check Icon -->
  <rect x="300" y="74" width="180" height="42" rx="12" fill="#e8f4ec" clip-path="url(#flowchart-clip)" />
  <rect x="300" y="116" width="180" height="12" fill="#e8f4ec" clip-path="url(#flowchart-clip)" />
  <circle cx="318" cy="101" r="10" fill="#1a7a3a" />
  <path d="M 314 101 L 317 104 L 323 98" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  <text x="334" y="99" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b">Portable XRF</text>
  <text x="334" y="114" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#1a7a3a">Real-time Soil Spec</text>

  <!-- Right Card Illustration -->
  <rect x="316" y="140" width="148" height="148" rx="8" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#d1e7d6" stroke-width="1" />
  
  <!-- Device Body -->
  <rect x="358" y="164" width="64" height="90" rx="8" fill="#1a7a3a" />
  
  <!-- Screen -->
  <rect x="366" y="176" width="48" height="40" rx="4" fill="#d1e7d6" />
  <!-- Screen Content (Spectrum) -->
  <polyline points="368,210 374,200 380,205 386,192 392,198 398,188 404,195 410,186" fill="none" stroke="#145c2d" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  <circle cx="386" cy="192" r="2.5" fill="#d97706" />

  <!-- Screen Text -->
  <text x="390" y="230" text-anchor="middle" font-family="monospace" font-size="8" fill="#e8f4ec">pXRF READY</text>

  <!-- Grip Detail -->

  <!-- Soil Sample Pile -->

  <path d="M 336 254 L 344 254 L 340 248 Z" fill="#b45309" opacity="0.6" />

  <!-- Probe Beam -->

  <circle cx="390" cy="246" r="3" fill="#d97706" />
  <polygon points="386,250 390,260 394,250" fill="#d97706" />

  <rect x="30" y="318" width="450" height="30" rx="6" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="1" />
